training.seed_rationale: Keep first model seed to compare objective rather than introduce a random-seed change; this supersedes the optional seed25 proposal before second training begins.

training.gate: Readback and input audit, zero premature and zero missed development episodes required before describing the candidate as offline-qualified; offline qualification does not establish physical success.

rgb_candidate.change: Larger near-field camera-servo correction only with repeated supported own-RGB evidence and sufficiently large vertical error; original trajectory/settling/new-image/final approach/grasp gates retained.
rgb_candidate.diagnostic_gate: Two original-spawn runs after immutable v28 source freeze, each max350wall seconds; both preserved, no failed time counted as speed gain.
rgb_candidate.qualification: After diagnostics, freeze at least three further unseen nearby spawn triples and compare each against v27 RGB under same local native conditions; all proposed cases must be recorded before outcomes.
rgb_candidate.speed_expectation: Saved actual RGB gates activate for initial large-error frames only; 20s gain is not established and is not assumed.
rgb_candidate.tracking_change: After existing cyan/KLT paths fail, permit direct cyan reacquisition only from current paired own/TOP RGB, recent direct-silhouette motion and observation time interval, unique matching foreground silhouette and fresh attachment. No blind proxy location or relaxed issue TTL. Thresholds and regression fixtures freeze before refinement outcomes.
rgb_candidate.causal_scope: Compare the combined refined RGB controller package (near-field servo and time-aware direct cargo reacquisition). Do not attribute full-run differences to either change separately.
